description:
In Episode 235 we discuss some possibilities of how the externalisation of the hierarchy, that Alice Bailey said would have its first stage start in 2025, might come to fruition. With all sorts of interesting things happening, such as Israel hailing Donald Trump as the modern Cyrus, King Charles receiving a seat/throne next to the pope in the Vatican praying together and discussing the climate problem while Bill Gates does a 180 turn on it, and also the highly speculated 3I/Atlas interstellar object. We might be on the verge of some cataclysmic events, will we be able to stand?

#WhatsUpProf #Prophecy #BibleTruth #ThreeAngelsMessages #endtimes
